deadbushbonemeal.book.start.text: Dead bushes and spore blossoms grow with bone meal now, the same way firefly bushes do. And dead bushes always drop themselves: no shears needed.
deadbushbonemeal.book.start.motto: "Dead? It just needed a little encouragement."
deadbushbonemeal.book.start.step1: Find a dead bush in a desert or badlands and break it. It drops itself.
deadbushbonemeal.book.start.step2: Plant it on sand, terracotta or dirt.
deadbushbonemeal.book.start.step3: Right-click it with bone meal: a second bush grows next to it.
deadbushbonemeal.book.start.firefly: Firefly bushes now also spread onto ground one block higher or lower.
deadbushbonemeal.book.start.recipe: A new guide: a book and a dead bush.
deadbushbonemeal.book.bush.text: The vanilla dead bush, now a plant you can farm.
deadbushbonemeal.book.bush.finding: Dead bushes grow in deserts, badlands and wooded badlands, on sand and terracotta.
deadbushbonemeal.book.bush.bonemeal: Bone meal places a new dead bush on a free block beside it, picked at random. It follows the ground one block up or down.
deadbushbonemeal.book.bush.ground: The new bush needs air and ground a dead bush can stand on. Without such a spot, the bone meal is kept.
deadbushbonemeal.book.bush.dispenser: Dispensers with bone meal spread dead bushes too.
deadbushbonemeal.book.bush.drop: Broken with any tool or by hand, a dead bush drops itself instead of sticks.
deadbushbonemeal.book.blossom.text: The vanilla spore blossom, now a plant you can multiply.
deadbushbonemeal.book.blossom.finding: Spore blossoms hang from the ceilings of lush caves. Broken, they drop themselves.
deadbushbonemeal.book.blossom.bonemeal: Bone meal places a new spore blossom on a free block beside it, picked at random. It follows the ceiling one block up or down.
deadbushbonemeal.book.blossom.ceiling: The new blossom needs air and a solid block above it to hang from. Without such a spot, the bone meal is kept.
deadbushbonemeal.book.blossom.dispenser: Dispensers with bone meal spread spore blossoms too.
